Dear Sophia,

I wanted to make you a little something that feels like the lights on your photos; soft, warm, ethereal and a little bit magical, baby.

Thank you for being exactly who you are, baby. I hope this year is gentle, golden, happy and full of everything you’ve been quietly wishing for.

I genuinely love you, baby. I truly do love you in many ways more than you could possibly ever know, and I will show you just how much I love you. Just like how beautiful you are, I will forever always love you in all the ways there are, my baby Sophia.

I’m so glad that you exist, Sophia.

Forever yours,
Gian
